summary: This video showcases an updated Summons team composition competing in the Crown Contest against the Fire Guardian boss, reaching over 3.77 billion damage. The featured lineup consists of Lelwanis, Sintrellia, Irzillas, Bernade, and The Dark Lady. Build recommendations highlight prioritizing full damage stats on Lelwanis and stacking maximum Attack on Sintrellia. Defensive stats are assigned to Irzillas to ensure frontline survival, while Bernade uses the Puppeteer set and The Dark Lady uses the Witches set.

heroes.name: Lelwanis
heroes.note: Built with full damage stats, focusing on high Attack, Crit Rate, and Crit Damage.

heroes.name: Sintrellia
heroes.note: Built with as much Attack stat as possible to maximize team efficiency.

heroes.name: Irzillas
heroes.note: Built with heavy defensive stats focusing on maximum HP and Defense.

heroes.name: Bernade
heroes.note: Equipped with the Puppeteer gear set.

heroes.name: The Dark Lady
heroes.note: Equipped with the Witches gear set.

teams.note: Scored 3,778,797,742 total damage against the Fire Guardian boss.

tips: Build Lelwanis with full damage stats including high Crit Rate and Crit Damage for maximum output.
Stack as much Attack as possible on Sintrellia to optimize her scaling.
Equip Irzillas with heavy defensive gear (HP and Defense) to take damage for the team.
Use the Puppeteer set on Bernade and the Witches set on The Dark Lady.
